about: THE MARKET's level: where every place is. Map tiles, x east, y north; the block runs from front y -77 back to -92.4. The builders read this file; the map editor exports it. A place's face (n, e, s or w; n if none) is the side its front looks out of, onto its street.

sections.note: the eight sections round Central Park, 4 across and 2 up, each A's size; ids[col][row]; ring: the park inside the ring street, the street's outer edge, its sidewalks' width, the depth of the row of buildings on its outer side, then the water and its shore walk past the top and bottom rows

places.note: the skate park (src/111fd-skatepark.js), out in the open in this section's park: its middle, the way its gate faces, its size in x and y (map units)

sides.note: sidewalk widths, outer then park side: ns the south and north streets (Market St), we the west and east (West St)

loop.note: THE LOOP: the subway under the ring streets. tracks are the rails' lines (map tiles) round the ring, r the corners' radius; trains run the timetable from the clock, stopping dwell seconds at every station; speed tiles/s, accel tiles/s/s

places.name: SUBWAY STAIRS
places.note: on the Hudson promenade in front of the garage by the Bookstore (owner, 8 Nov 2026)

guitar.note: the park's guitar on its stand, anyone's to play (146zob-guitar): park tiles, hd the way it faces in degrees

bigLake.note: THE BIG LAKE (owner, 7 Nov 2026): centred on the park's north-east corner, rx by ry map tiles; a quarter in Section A, the rest past the forcefield, seen, never walked; the brook runs out of it to THE LAKE (the pond)

brook.note: the brook's course from its spring to the lake (map tiles); the lake's middle ends it

sites.note: the bath house on its island in the lake: no trees or paths here
where the island's footbridge lands: no trees here

parkPlaces.stallsNote: the park wall's stalls (owner, 8 Nov 2026): side w or e of the park gate, slot 0 nearest it; merchant the character who keeps it, goods what its table shows (STALL.GOODS)

islands.note: the bath house's island in the middle of the lake (owner, 8 Nov 2026): ghosts float out to it

bridges.note: the bath house island's footbridge to the shore, walked off once you are alive again (owner, 8 Nov 2026)

editor.note: the editor's own extras (added things, trees, looks); the game does not read these yet

bigTrees.note: THE BIG TREES (owner, 7 Nov 2026): giants in the middle of the park, map tiles; kind A level branch, B rising, C low and sagging; face: where the big branch reaches, degrees; climb: SPACE next to it climbs it; s: its size against those (owner, 8 Nov 2026: "add 12 more large trees ranging from 25-50% smaller as they get further [from the] middle. tallest tree in middle")

edge.note: THE NEW MAP'S EDGES (owner, 6 Nov 2026): lines in map tiles you cannot cross (a forcefield where you press on one); past them only the backdrop, seen, never walked

ground.note: the land past the edges (owner, 7 Nov 2026: "set a base color for far off distance things like grass"): one low-res grass ground under everything outside the section, the big lake's whole shore in it (box x0, y0, x1, y1 in tiles; tiles a pixel; grass and water colours)

strips.note: the streets carried on past the edges, low-res ground (x0, y0, x1, y1, kind)

park.note: Central Park's edge along West St drawn the whole way, past the draw distance and past the map's edge: a wall just inside the real one and bands of plain low trees (x0, y0, x1, y1 in tiles; north of the map the park goes on to the horizon, no city on its side); east of the map too, beside Market St (owner, 8 Nov 2026)

city.note: the far city (owner, 8 Nov 2026): past the backdrop to the end of the view, plain shapes; past that a painted ring. In tiles: center, R (how far the shapes go), near (x0,y0,x1,y1: the map and its backdrop, left alone), water (y bands with none), lowY/lowK (past this y the city is lower, the far shore), base (lowest, highest), clusters (x, y, peak, radius: the tall towers), block (x, y), fade (from, to: into the horizon's colour), ring (the painted layers' distances), panorama (the ring's radius), lands (y bands, what the ring's ground is that way: water, street or park)

far.note: the far city past the backdrop: (axis, from, to, across from, across to, lowest, highest storeys in tiles); shore: where the water past the river ends (the far bank, a map y); ends: how far the far water and its shore run (map x)

mirror.note: Market St past its ends (owner, 8 Nov 2026: "lets make the street look the same all the way down"): the street's band (y0, y1 in tiles) drawn again mirrored at the forcefields (x: west, east), reach tiles out, from these builders' groups; each side drawn while you are within show tiles of it; the lawn and the far grass leave the street's ground (y0, y1) to it
